description: From the Pradera de San Marcos below the confluence, the Alcázar rises like a ship's prow at the center of the frame, its slate spires and stone walls floodlit against the night sky. The castle's dramatic position on the rocky crag is unmistakable — walls plunging down to the river gorge on either side. Segovia's fairy-tale fortress glows above the dark rivers, every bit the castle of storybooks.
